title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Clawitzer Mega Symphonia 020/063 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Clawitzer 020/063 Rare Mega Symphonia Pokemon Japanese Holo is a highly collectible card from the Pokémon TCG set. This water type Pokémon card features Clawitzer, a Stage 1 Pokemon, illustrated by Anesaki Dynamic. Manufactured by Nintendo in Japan, this holo card is part of the Mega Symphonia set released in 2025. The card is made of durable card stock material and is ideal for collectors and players aged 6 and above. With its rarity and unique design, this Clawitzer card is a prized addition to any Pokemon card collection.
